notes: Partners = the gene's top-10 zavg_BEF neighbours (results/ledger/u_partners.tsv, rank <= 10). Symbol mapping for 2019-era catalogues: HGNC approved, then unique previous symbols, then unique aliases.

Replogle 2022: no gene-cluster assignment file in data/raw/replogle2022_perturbseq (annotated_embedding_coordinates.csv holds embedding coordinates only) -> unavailable. Pan 2018 (Cell Systems): Cell Press SI returned HTTP 403 (bot protection), Europe PMC: not open access, PMC author manuscript supplement is a PDF only -> not obtainable. FIREWORKS 2021: the only supplementary file is the 'undruggables' co-essential-partner table (not a genome-wide prediction table) -> not obtainable.

Overlap flags say that the co-essential (or physical) relationship between the gene and >= 1 of its own top-10 partners was already published; they do not check that the resource assigned the same function. Only Wainberg Supp. Data 3 is an explicit function prediction for uncharacterised genes.
